inventory_boundary.reason: The complete PDF was audited through Supplement Figure 8 and the end of the AB-stacking discussion.

acceptance_criteria: All paper-scale conditions are hash-bound, checkpointed and resumable.
Normalization, convergence, Hermiticity and printed transition neighborhoods pass.
Aggregation fails closed on missing, stale, overlapping or corrupt shards.
Every indispensable QE, pseudopotential, structure, convergence and Wannier input is source-traced and hash-bound before execution.
The parameterized QE-to-Wannier plan is frozen for both displacements and fails closed while any required input is absent.
No source pixels, author code, author arrays, PDF or raw paper asset enters the numerical runner.
